basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Records use of a resource over an interval, not a stock.
Power is a rate; energy is a quantity over time.

may: Record meter readings and derive consumption.
Allocate shared consumption with a stated method.
mustNot: Control meters or dispatch resources without authority.
requiresHuman: Resolving billing disputes and corrections to billed consumption.
Approving consumption figures for environmental or regulatory reports.

considerations: Household consumption reveals occupancy and habits.
Water and energy scarcity make fair allocation matter.

properties.reason: A consumption record holds measured amounts as data; the consuming asset carries the physical properties.

items: A consumption record has a consumer, resource, interval, quantity, unit and meter or method.
Often confused with a meter reading, an invoice and an emission.
